$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a lime-plaster studio's content seed (Casa Cal, Santa Barbara), a burnt-clay brand, and the limewash register. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Plaster Studio
description: A lime-plaster studio's site told in rooms: Casa Cal in Santa Barbara. The home is a stack of full-bleed room photographs at one size — a terracotta living room under "Walls with weather in them.", then a sage tadelakt bath, a bone limewash stair, and an ochre marmorino dining room, each with its room and finish written into the foot of the photograph — closing on one line and a "Request a visit." link. The finishes with per-square-foot prices, before/after rooms, the studio's story, home-visit booking, and a request form keep their own pages. Bone, umber, and burnt clay in Castoro over Spectral. Flexes to limewash and Venetian-plaster studios, decorative painters, tile and stone makers, and any trade whose work is a room.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this trade's own provider, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Home visit
types.description: An hour at the house with Cal, free — the rooms, the light, the walls under the paint, and which finish suits each room.

types.name: Sample-board review
types.description: Your sample boards held to your walls, then a written estimate room by room.

theme.$comment: Burnt clay as the brand: on the limewash register the accent is the one ask and the links — the rooms carry the color. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so keeping the values identical to the preset's own accents re-inks app surfaces without shifting the pages. mode light opens on the bone ground (the base contractor opens dark, and theme merges shallowly); the shared servicesShell's full-width chrome stays — framestack floats it over the first room.

landing.$comment: The pin: the limewash register and the stack home — the seed sets home.stack, so the home is the first room with its line (hero full-bleed-media), the other rooms edge to edge at the hero's size with their captions in the photographs (gallery sequence + captionStack overlay-start), and the closing line over the visit link (cta-banner colophon, align start). The other pages keep the base's skeletons with this seed's content; resolveCatalog puts these in place of the base's pages.
